headline: Cia Ferrara: "If diesel reaches €3, it's better to stop farming" | estense.com Ferrara
summary: Cia Ferrara president Piva voiced concern over production damage from hail and drought, and over constant rises in production costs. He said farming would be better stopped if diesel reaches €3.
why: Diesel is a major input cost for agriculture, so fuel price rises directly affect farm margins and food production costs.
